scripts.check: node -e "import('node:fs').then(async fs=>{const p=await import('node:path'),cp=await import('node:child_process');const walk=d=>fs.readdirSync(d,{withFileTypes:true}).flatMap(e=>e.isDirectory()?walk(p.join(d,e.name)):/\.(?:js|mjs)$/.test(e.name)?[p.join(d,e.name)]:[]);for(const dir of ['src','scripts','apps/web/src','test'])for(const f of walk(dir))cp.execFileSync(process.execPath,['--check',f],{stdio:'inherit'});})"
